name: pr-triage-seed
description: Seed benchmark for pull request triage. Small and explicitly NOT human-validated: the labels below were produced by the assistant reasoning over each pull request's own title, description and changed files. They exist to smoke-test the harness end to end and to show what a report looks like. They must not be cited as human-validated accuracy, and any claim about decision quality needs a human-labelled dataset of at least 30 cases, per the specification. The `label_source` field carries this provenance into every report.
